detaileddescription.para: The unit is always on the tick labels, whatever unitPosition says, and label.unitText is empty. Decimals follow the tick step in each label's own prefix. A zero tick takes the prefix of the tick step, as in "0 mm, 2 mm, 4 mm", and a zero readout the prefix of its resolution. On a logarithmic axis each decade is a plain number in its own prefix: "1 mm, 10 mm, 100 mm, 1 m". allowedPrefixes applies to each label, and customPrefix is not called.

The axis label shows the prefixed unit through label.unitText, and the tick labels show only numbers.
Each tick label is followed by a space and the prefixed unit, such as "10 mm", or "10³ mm" on a logarithmic axis, and label.unitText is empty. An empty prefixed unit adds nothing.

detaileddescription.para: A prefix outside allowedPrefixes snaps to the allowed prefix with the largest power of ten not above it, or to the smallest allowed prefix. "µ" (U+00B5), "μ" (U+03BC), and "u" all mean micro and read back as "µ" (U+00B5). An unknown symbol is ignored with a warning.

detaileddescription.para: Receives the visible range and an array of the visible major tick values, all in the base unit. Called on the GUI thread once per tick computation. A result outside allowedPrefixes snaps as with fixedPrefix. An exception, a result that is not a string, or an unknown symbol falls back to LargestMagnitude with a warning.

briefdescription.para: Unit prefix symbols the tick labels may use, with "" for the bare unit. Default: every power-of-1000 prefix from quecto ("q") to quetta ("Q"), and "".

detaileddescription.para: Any SI prefix may be listed, including "c", "d", "da", and "h". "µ" (U+00B5), "μ" (U+03BC), and "u" all mean micro, written as "µ" (U+00B5). An unknown symbol is ignored with a warning. An empty list turns prefixing off: values are written unscaled in the bare unit.
Reads back the prefixes in effect, sorted by ascending power of ten, without duplicates or unknown symbols, and with micro as "µ" (U+00B5). Assign undefined to restore the default.

briefdescription.para: Returns value in the unit prefix of tickSetFormat, or in its own prefix with prefixMode PerTick, followed by a space and the prefixed unit, such as "12.3 mm".
Numeric tick label formatter that writes the tick labels in a unit with an automatic SI unit prefix.

detaileddescription.para: The data stays in the base unit. All tick labels share one unit prefix chosen from the visible major ticks, and the axis label shows the prefixed unit: unit "m" over 0–0.004 gives the tick labels 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and the axis label "Distance (mm)". Decimals follow the tick step in the prefixed unit, as with NumericTickLabelFormatter. On a logarithmic axis the tick labels stay powers of ten in the prefixed unit: 0.000001–0.001 gives 10⁻³ to 10⁰ with "Distance (mm)". The prefix depends only on the visible range, so each axis sharing one formatter picks its own.

With unitPosition TickLabels, each tick label carries the prefixed unit instead ("0 mm", "1 mm") and the axis label shows only its text. With prefixMode PerTick, each tick label picks its own prefix and carries it: "500 mm, 1.0 m, 1.5 m".

A tickLabel callback receives the value and the tick step in the prefixed unit; on a logarithmic axis the tick step is the value itself. Its result replaces only the number: with unitPosition TickLabels the prefixed unit is still appended, as in formatValue().
